nodes.label: Creative North Star: El Mostrador
nodes.rationale: A counter, not a dashboard: catalog grid left, fixed ticket right, charge button shows the amount; everything else supports the sell gesture. Rejected stacked-button line form (old POS), shortcut chips inside buttons, and branded teal accent resembling a competitor.

nodes.label: The One Accent Rule
nodes.rationale: Single accent per install means action or selection only; components request it via var(--accent) so the business color reaches everything.

nodes.label: The Own Color Rule
nodes.rationale: Business picks the hue, system guarantees legibility by darkening/lightening in 6% steps until 4.5:1 contrast.

nodes.label: The Two Lines Rule (line vs hair)
nodes.rationale: line (>=3:1) bounds controls, hair only separates; a control border never uses hair.
nodes.norm_label: the two lines rule (line vs hair)

nodes.label: The Tested Pair Rule
nodes.rationale: Every new color goes into TEMAS in both themes and combinaciones() with its minimum; test also runs with eight sample business colors. If the test does not cover it, it is not used.

nodes.label: The Tabular Money Rule
nodes.rationale: All money and quantities use tabular-nums, right aligned, colon sign attached, dot thousands, no decimals.

nodes.label: The Fixed Ticket Rule
nodes.rationale: Ticket never scrolls with catalog; only its lines scroll; Cobrar always visible.

nodes.label: Configuration, not code (multi-business reuse)
nodes.rationale: One app reused across 4 bookstores/florists; everything that differs (departments, payment methods, IVA, ticket) is configuration.

nodes.label: Product Principles
nodes.rationale: Selling first; few words; configuration not code; nothing is lost (persistent held sales, sale saved even if printing fails).

nodes.label: Decision: Tauri vs Electron
nodes.rationale: Stay with Tauri if scanner and RAW spooler printing pass tests; Electron only if WebView2 or RAW printing fail; installer size 3-10 MB vs 80-150 MB.

nodes.label: SQLCipher database encryption with DPAPI key
nodes.rationale: Evaluated against encrypting only backups; chose SQLCipher. Does not protect against same-user malware or Windows admin.

nodes.label: Single-use owner discount authorization token
nodes.rationale: Previously the screen sent the owner id and it was trusted; now owner PIN yields a 30-minute single-use token bound to sale and percentage.
